title: National Commission must function at specified locations
description: The National Commission must function at the National Capital Region and other notified places

limitations: at such other places as the Central Government may in consultation with the National Commission notify in the Official Gazette
at regional Benches of the National Commission, at such places, as the Central Government deems fit
